nodes.rationale: Normalizes whitespace and quote characters; requires exact or ≥85% 3-word-shingle match; non-verbatim facts dropped and logged so the UI can claim every fact is backed by the page.

nodes.label: selectSnapshotsForRun(competitorId, cutoffDate)
nodes.rationale: Returns snapshots with publishedAt <= cutoff that have no facts yet, so Run 2 only processes pages Run 1 did not see.

nodes.label: Decision: seeded snapshot corpus as the spine
nodes.norm_label: decision: seeded snapshot corpus as the spine
nodes.rationale: Real, dated, unedited pages grouped into runs by cutoff; live fetches save as identical snapshots so nothing downstream can tell them apart; UI discloses 'Replaying snapshots captured on [dates]'.

nodes.label: Diff-only change detection (diff.ts)
nodes.rationale: Two captures of the same URL are compared line-by-line in code first; only added/removed lines go to the model, identical captures cost no call.

nodes.label: Facts vs inference prompt rule
nodes.rationale: Extraction forbids inferring intent; inference happens only in synthesis where every hypothesis update must cite fact ids.

nodes.label: insertSnapshotRecord helper shared by seed and live
nodes.norm_label: insertsnapshotrecord helper shared by seed and live
nodes.rationale: Factored so seeded and live records are identical in shape.

nodes.label: Wayback id_ capture for original HTML
nodes.norm_label: wayback id_ capture for original html
nodes.rationale: The id_ flag returns the original HTML without the Wayback toolbar; explicit timestamps make publication dates provable.

nodes.label: Conflict question citing both facts
nodes.rationale: Contradictory facts (15 vs 20 accounts, $100 vs $120 with no stated cadence) should surface as an open question for a human, not be smoothed into a 'limit is in flux' hypothesis.

nodes.label: Wayback CDX client (src/lib/ingest/wayback.ts listCaptures)
nodes.rationale: Politeness: 1 req/s, 60 s timeout, Retry-After honoured on 429/503 (max 3), 200 CDX calls per job budget, because the CDX server publishes no rate limit and asks bulk users to page politely.

nodes.label: planBackfill (src/lib/backfill/plan.ts)
nodes.rationale: Quarterly cutoffs ascending; consecutive identical digests deduped to skip unchanged content.

nodes.label: Caddy basic_auth with public route exemptions
nodes.norm_label: caddy basic_auth with public route exemptions

nodes.label: Caddyfile reverse proxy
nodes.rationale: flush_interval -1 keeps the NDJSON run stream unbuffered; automatic TLS once DNS points at the VPS.

nodes.label: Deployment security basics
nodes.rationale: Secrets only in .env, expiring /r/* tokens, verified webhook signatures, fetchers refuse private IPs/localhost, basic_auth covers /api/runs and /ops, no NEXT_PUBLIC secrets.
